technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Mix of present used technologies in Europe

# Included processes
This module includes the material and energy efforts for: preparation and sorting of cullets, melting, forming of glass containers, cooling down, packaging and palletting until glass containers are ready for transport to customer. Transports for the input materials are included as well as direct emissions to air, waste water and waste.
